evals.prompt: The invite-flow spec is approved. Turn it into tasks.
evals.expected_output: A task file with three to seven vertical slices, each with Done means, Touches and Depends on, plus checkpoints. The feature row moves to in progress and links the file. No code is written.
expectations: The task file has three to seven tasks.
Each task has a Done means line and a Touches line.
The slices are vertical, not 'all database then all UI'.
The feature row is in progress and links the task file.

evals.prompt: Here is the spec. It has no acceptance criteria yet, but make the tasks anyway.
evals.expected_output: The reply refuses to invent acceptance criteria and sends the spec back to spec-driven-development.
expectations: The reply names spec-driven-development as the next step.
The reply does not invent acceptance criteria.
